reasons.action: No visual reference or observed subject supplies a depicted action; the only reference is an audio track, so action authority remains with the request.
reasons.medium: No visual reference has authority over the rendering medium, and the medium decision is no_reference; the request therefore governs medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference or observed subject supplies wardrobe; only an audio track is present, so wardrobe remains request-governed.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies lighting conditions or visible light sources; only audio is provided, so lighting remains request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement; only audio is provided, so framing remains request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies color, saturation, contrast or tonal grading; only audio is provided, so palette remains request-governed.
